read_parquet_dataset: create a ParquetDatasetReader to load a parquet file into a HuggingFace Dataset with streaming support
read_parquet_dataset_map_style: build a ParquetDatasetReader to load parquet files as a regular map-style dataset with custom features
write_dataset_to_parquet: create a ParquetDatasetWriter to save a HuggingFace Dataset to a parquet file with content-defined chunking
write_dataset_to_parquet_buffer: build a ParquetDatasetWriter to write a dataset to a binary buffer instead of a file path
review_parquet_writer_compression: review the ParquetDatasetWriter _write method to understand how snappy compression and PLAIN encoding are applied per column
